description: This file contains an example implementation of Power Iteration Clustering (PIC) using Apache Spark's MLlib. It includes code for generating concentric circle data, configuring Spark, running the clustering algorithm, and outputting cluster assignments.

classes.name: PowerIterationClusteringExample
classes.description: Object containing the main method and clustering logic for the PIC example.

classes.name: PowerIterationClusteringExample.Params
classes.description: Case class for holding clustering parameters such as number of clusters, points, and iterations.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for the application; parses arguments and initiates clustering run.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Sets up Spark context, generates data, runs clustering, and outputs results.

methods.name: generateCircle
methods.description: Generates points on a circle with given radius and number of points.

methods.name: generateCirclesRdd
methods.description: Creates an RDD of pairwise distances between points on multiple circles, with similarity scores.

methods.name: gaussianSimilarity
methods.description: Calculates Gaussian similarity between two points.
